pre-3.0.0-4 · App separation and desktop customization

Refine the host API and move more app code, resources and settings into app packages. Cross-app features provide alternatives when Weather or Status is uninstalled.

Customize icon size, columns, labels, drag order, folders and system shortcuts, with separate phone and tablet layouts. In-app navigation keeps only Home.

The store adds download progress, cancellation, retry, batch updates, compatibility status, permissions and release notes. A failed first launch can restore the previous app package.

Manage storage, data transfer, caches and data deletion for every app, including retained data from uninstalled apps. Strengthen import isolation and rollback.

Restore supported settings and task, course, place and music editing drafts after activity recreation. Music imports add stages, timing, result reports and failed-item retry.

Restore titles for the previous two updates, clarify how to start waiting for a connection, and record future command and communication plans.
